ambient.intent: Non-combat presence — no hunt, no attacks.

chase.intent: Close and pursue living targets. Stupid: does not distinguish creatures (includes monsters).

demolish.intent: Building-first chew; also stupid about creatures when AI is wired.

grow.intent: Grown-giant path — debris scrape vs buildings and player pressure.

guard.intent: Hold a post; engage the player. Selective — no pack infighting.

skirmish.intent: Standoff / ranged pressure — hunt player and peds; no infighting or structure chew. Attack pool is the full caster/artillery set; AI selection among them is deferred.

wander_hunt.intent: Roam and hunt living targets like chase — stupid creature set.
